name: Boulderslide Cavern
summary: Boulderslide kobolds dig deep in Boulderslide Cavern, at the far end of Boulderslide Ravine. They search the stone for glowing mineral formations.

sections.title: The Resonite Dig
sections.body: Boulderslide kobolds have carved a stronghold into the Stonetalon crags. They dig frantically for resonite, a rare purple crystal embedded in the stone. Its glow carries traces of earthen magic, and the kobolds turn fiercely against anyone who approaches their excavation.

sections.title: The Slumbering Giant
sections.body: Goggeroc lies asleep inside a resonite cask deep in Boulderslide Cavern. The kobolds' digging has reached this ancient earthen, and their work around his resting place risks waking him. His primordial stone magic could bring sudden danger to the whole ravine.

faq.q: What are the kobolds mining here?
faq.answer: The kobolds mine resonite, a rare purple crystal embedded in the cavern walls. Faint earthen magic hums through it, and the kobolds guard their stores fiercely.
Goggeroc is an ancient earthen who sleeps inside a resonite cask deep in the cavern. The kobolds' digging near his resting place risks disturbing his centuries-long slumber.
Boulderslide Cavern lies at the far end of Boulderslide Ravine, in the craggy southern Stonetalon Mountains, just northeast of the path toward the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this cavern?
faq.answer: The Horde watches the cavern to curb the aggressive kobolds spreading through the ravine and to study the magical properties of the resonite they mine.

angles.text: Boulderslide kobolds tunnel relentlessly through the cavern, seeking glowing veins of magical resonite.
Resonite and the sleeping earthen Goggeroc both carry primordial earth magic, an echo of the world's ancient stone shapers.
